data.title: What's next as Bitcoin, Ethereum and XRP hold key support? | FXStreet
data.description: Bitcoin (BTC) maintains a neutral-to-bullish outlook, trading above $65,000 on Monday. Ethereum (ETH) is approaching the key supply and inflection point $2,000, while Ripple (XRP) hovers slightly above $1.10, underscoring a marginal improvement in the broader cryptocurrency market sentiment.
